name: wmi
description: WMI event subscription seats: install, remove, and list the bound triples (event filter, command-line consumer, binding) in the repository under ROOT\SUBSCRIPTION -- persist.wmi's execution half packed as the artifact an implant loads through module.load.

opsec.notes: Server side, the package lands as descriptor rows and one artifact file under the module store -- no code runs in the teamserver. On the target, the implant half loads from staged task content, mapped in memory on Windows -- the module itself drops no file. Every write needs an elevated implant: the repository's PutInstance and DeleteInstance under ROOT\SUBSCRIPTION are the administrator's calls. The seat lives entirely in the on-disk WMI repository, its query and command line plain to any blue-team reader that enumerates __FilterToConsumerBinding, and it fires on its trigger across reboots while it sits.
